title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced the National Nutrition Cluster&39;s capacity and expanded it to 20 districts. Severe wasting treatment improved from 15,551 cases in 2023 to 24,277 in 2024, covering 45 per cent of the national caseload. However, low active case-finding and last mile distribution challenges persist, limiting treatment coverage in under-resourced districts.
